metadata.title: Merchant of Record and Payment Gateway Real Fee Benchmark on a $20 Cross-Border AI SaaS Subscription (November 2026)
metadata.description: Itemized fee audit comparing what an AI SaaS developer actually keeps from a $20/month cross-border subscription once hidden surcharges (international cards, FX conversion, recurring billing, sales tax calculation, fraud screening, and payout fees) are included across Dodo Payments (partner rate $1.16–$1.18 taken vs default $1.60), Waffo Pancake ($1.28), Creem ($1.37), Paddle ($1.50), Stripe Hong Kong full SaaS stack (~$1.79), Polar ($1.80), and Lemon Squeezy ($2.08, shutting down March 31, 2027). Full analysis at https://jasonzhu.ai/en/blog/dodo-payments-waffo-ai-saas-fee-comparison.
keywords: Dodo Payments vs Waffo vs Stripe
